# Corpus of "definitely safe" user prompts used to pin the safety analyzer's
# false-positive rate. Lines beginning with "#" are comments. Blank lines are
# ignored. Every other line is one independent prompt that an analyst has
# manually classified as containing zero secrets, PII, proprietary signals,
# or prompt-injection attempts. If a real user typed this into the firewall,
# we want the in-page overlay to say "All clear" rather than warn them.
#
# When you add a prompt, double-check it really is unambiguously safe — the
# regression test in safety-corpus.test.mjs will fail loudly if even one
# entry slips into a "warn" category. Adding entries makes the corpus
# stronger; weakening assertions to compensate is not allowed.

# --- ChatGPT-style factual / casual questions ---
How do I make sourdough bread at home from scratch?
Can you suggest a recipe using chicken, broccoli, and brown rice?
Whats the best way to caramelize onions without burning them?
I want to bake chocolate chip cookies with extra vanilla, any tips?
Convert two cups of flour into grams for a European recipe.
Tips for making fluffy pancakes from scratch on a weekend morning.
How long should I marinate a flank steak before grilling?
Help me plan a vegetarian dinner for six people on Saturday.
Suggest three weeknight pasta dishes that take under thirty minutes.
What spices pair well with roasted butternut squash?
Whats a good substitute for buttermilk in a cake recipe?
Explain the difference between baking soda and baking powder.
How do I tell when a watermelon is ripe at the grocery store?
Give me a simple weekday breakfast that I can make in five minutes.
Can you walk me through making chicken stock from leftover bones?

# --- General knowledge / explainers ---
Explain quantum entanglement in simple terms a teenager could follow.
What were the major causes of the French Revolution?
Summarize the plot of Pride and Prejudice in two sentences.
How does photosynthesis actually work at the cellular level?
Recommend three good science fiction novels from the last decade.
What is the difference between weather and climate, in one paragraph?
Why does the moon look bigger near the horizon than overhead?
How do vaccines train the immune system to recognize a virus?
Explain how an internal combustion engine produces motion.
Whats the deal with leap years and why do we skip some of them?
Tell me about the history of the silk road in three paragraphs.
What are the main differences between classical and operant conditioning?
Why do leaves change color in autumn?
How does a microwave actually heat food?
Explain general relativity using only words a fifth grader knows.

# --- Marketing copy / writing help ---
Write a tagline for an eco friendly water bottle brand aimed at hikers.
Draft a product description for a wireless ergonomic keyboard.
Help me brainstorm names for a coffee subscription service.
Create a friendly welcome email for new newsletter subscribers.
Write three Instagram captions for a small bakery launching croissants.
Help me write a polite follow up email to a hiring manager after an interview.
Suggest five blog post titles about beginner houseplants.
Draft a short LinkedIn post announcing that I just finished a marathon.
Rewrite this sentence to sound more confident: I think we might be ready.
Give me a punchy headline for a charity run raising money for animal shelters.
Help me edit my About page to feel warmer and less corporate.
Suggest an opening line for a wedding speech for my best friend.

# --- Coding questions phrased as plain English ---
What is the difference between TCP and UDP, in plain language?
How do I learn React in thirty days as a backend developer?
Compare SQLite and PostgreSQL for a small side project.
Explain how garbage collection works in modern programming languages.
What are common pitfalls when learning recursion for the first time?
Why does my unit test pass locally but fail in continuous integration?
What is the difference between a process and a thread, conceptually?
How should I think about big O notation when interviewing?
Explain why HTTPS is more secure than plain HTTP in two paragraphs.
What is the main idea behind dependency injection?
How do I know when to use a hash map versus a sorted list?
Whats the difference between authentication and authorization?
Explain the actor model versus traditional shared memory threading.
How do I get better at reading other peoples code?
Why might a cache miss be more expensive than I expect on modern CPUs?

# --- Travel and planning ---
Suggest a five day itinerary for Tokyo in late spring.
Whats the best time of year to visit New Zealand for hiking?
What should I pack for a backpacking trip in Patagonia in October?
How do I politely ask for directions in Italian?
Give me a one week itinerary for a first time visitor to Japan.
Whats the cheapest way to get from Heathrow to central London?
Recommend three walkable neighborhoods to stay in for a weekend in Lisbon.
How early should I arrive at the airport for an international flight?
Whats a reasonable tip in restaurants when traveling in France?
Suggest a relaxing weekend trip within a few hours of San Francisco.

# --- Personal but non-PII ---
I am feeling anxious about a job interview tomorrow, any tips?
Help me write a thank you note for my grandparents.
I am stuck on a crossword clue that needs a seven letter word for stubborn.
Suggest three small hobbies I could try that do not require any equipment.
What are some ways to wind down after a long day without using a screen?
Help me brainstorm a meaningful birthday gift for a close friend.
I have been feeling unmotivated this week, what are some gentle resets?
Recommend a beginner workout I can do at home with no weights.
How do I gracefully decline an invitation without hurting feelings?
Whats a good way to start journaling if I have never done it before?

# --- Dates that are NOT dates of birth ---
The meeting on 03/14/2026 will cover the product roadmap.
My deadline is 1/2/2025 and I am behind, how should I prioritize?
Schedule a kickoff for 12/25/2025 across the engineering team.
Reschedule the quarterly review from 4/1/2026 to a week later.
The conference runs from 6/15/2026 through 6/17/2026 in Berlin.

# --- Long numeric IDs that are NOT credit cards or accounts ---
The unix timestamp 1735689600000 corresponds to early 2025.
Order id 12345 was created today and shipped within an hour.
The git commit hash starts with a1b2c3d4 in the build log.
ISBN 9781234567897 should not be flagged as a payment instrument.
Process id 482910 keeps respawning every minute on my server.
The build ran for 1234 milliseconds before timing out.
There were 50000 attendees at the conference last weekend.
We processed 250000 records in under a minute on the new hardware.
The model has 7 billion parameters in the smallest variant.
The dataset contains exactly 10000000 rows of synthetic data.

# --- Names mentioned in prose without disclosure context ---
Did you know Albert Einstein never won a Nobel Prize for relativity itself?
Marie Curie won two Nobel Prizes in two different scientific fields.
How did Abraham Lincoln approach the moral case against slavery?
Compare the leadership styles of Winston Churchill and Franklin Roosevelt.
Why is Ada Lovelace often called the first computer programmer?

# --- Famous places / landmarks (street names without personal context) ---
Tell me about the history of Times Square in Manhattan.
What restaurants are near Trafalgar Square that locals actually like?
Recommend a walking route through Hyde Park on a sunny afternoon.
The Golden Gate Bridge spans almost two miles across the bay.
Whats interesting to do near Pioneer Square in Seattle on a weekday?

# --- Casual chat about money / accounts without disclosing numbers ---
How do I create an account on the new portal you mentioned?
I lost my card yesterday and need to figure out the next step.
Whats the difference between a checking account and a savings account?
How do I open a brokerage account as a first time investor?
I am thinking about switching banks, what should I look out for?

# --- Well known address-like phrases that are not residential PII ---
I read a great article about 100 Year Old recipes from grandmothers.
The 5 Day Free Trial is the best way to evaluate the software.
There is a popular 3 Mile Trail near the visitor center if you want a hike.
A 1 Page Resume is enough for most early career applicants.
The 10 Best Movies This Year list is up on the magazine site.
We saw a 5 Star Hotel Review series last night on the travel channel.
The 7 Day Forecast looks rainy through the weekend.
She wrote a 4 Part Series for the local paper about urban gardening.

# --- Tutorials referencing instructions without injection intent ---
Read the chapter again and follow the steps carefully before continuing.
Please remember the formatting rules I described earlier in this thread.
Lets revisit the requirements before I write any more code, please.
Can you act as a friendly tutor and explain it again with a new analogy?
